Leave [B01]–[B07] blank for preschool staff.

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Form heading | NEEDS-YOU |
| [B08] Child’s name | NEEDS-YOU |
| [B08] Preschool or daycare name | NEEDS-YOU |
| [B09] Applicant’s name | GIVEN_P1 MIDDLE_P1 SURNAME_P1 |
| [B10] Applicant’s telephone | PHONE_P1 |
| [B11] Applicant’s email | NEEDS-YOU |
| [B12] Relationship to child | Aunt |
| [B30] Second emergency contact’s name | GIVEN_P1 MIDDLE_P1 SURNAME_P1 |
| [B30] Second emergency contact’s telephone | PHONE_P1 |

For [B10] and [B30], put the restored number in the slot that matches it: (C) cell, (W) work, or (H) home.

Use the preschool or daycare’s name in both the heading and [B08]. Add your email in [B11]. Leave the child’s name in [B08] and all of [B13]–[B29] blank for your sister, including the authorized pickup list and the first emergency contact.
